title: Impact cartography — self review scratch notes
content:
Purpose: quick, messy working notes to pull together evidence and asks for upcoming 1:1 and calibration. Not polished. Use bullets later for email to manager.

High-level claim I want to make:
- Established repeatable intake + screening flow for SRE hiring that reduced lead time from screen to offer by ~22 days (baseline Q3 2025 -> Q1 2026).
- Ran two targeted experiments on interviewer calibration (panel rubrics + 30-min debrief) that increased hiring manager satisfaction and reduced false negatives on IC-level candidates (anecdotal: 3 saved hires).
- Built an onboarding micro-playbook that cut time-to-first-meaningful-contribution for new senior engs from ~7w -> ~4w in pilot team.

Evidence (rough):
- Hiring funnel: sourced -> phone -> ons -> offer: snapshot 2026-01: sourced 320 -> phone 84 -> ons 16 -> offers 4. Time to offer median: 45d, new flow: target 23d. (see JIRA-POPS-1123 for full funnel table).
- Feedback excerpts: hiring manager (Infra) "faster, clearer feedback loop; fewer repeats" (Slack thread C12AB34XY).
- Onboarding playbook version 0.3 used by Platform Eng pilot: checklist, weekly sync templates, 2-week buddy schedule. Mentor survey (n=6): avg rating 4.2/5 for clarity.

Concrete examples / stories to tell in 1:1:
- Story 1: Sourced candidate turned out to be a strong match but flagged by old rubric; we adjusted rubric mid-process and re-evaluated -> offer accepted -> team velocity gain story (mention reduced ramp).
- Story 2: Onboarding reminder card reduced first-week blocker emails by 40% on pilot team (I can pull numbers from support inbox).

Asks I want from my manager (ranked):
1) Promotion calibration: ask for clear signal on readiness for L4->L5 (examples I should collect: three cross-team projects where I led ambiguity to outcome; three stakeholder testimonials).
2) Budget ask: two headcount credits to double interview rotation capacity for Q3. Rationale: projected hiring velocity + backlog risk.
3) Mentorship/coaching: block 1 hour/month with you for stakeholder negotiation shadowing.

Draft scripts (short, practice wording):
- Promotion opener: "I want to make the case for leveling—here are three evidence threads that show increasing breadth, influence, and decision ownership... can we map these to your calibration rubric?"
- Headcount ask: "We're forecasting a 30% higher demand from infra + private-deployments this year; with two additional interview credits we can maintain current cycle time while scaling quality."

Open questions / risks to address before send:
- Do we have enough longitudinal data to justify the reduced time-to-contribution claim? (Need to pull cohort ramp metrics: feature ownership, PR throughput weeks 1–12).
- What's the current promotion calibration timeline from EMs? Any freeze windows? (check calendar/people-ops pipeline).
- Are there competing asks for same headcount credits from other teams? (talk to Priya).

Actions (next 7 days):
- Pull ramp metrics for pilot cohort (ask Analytics team; ticket created: JIRA-ANALY-559).
- Compile 3 stakeholder quotes (Evan, Mei, Platform EM) and paste below.
- Draft a 1-page promo packet with timeline and concrete outcomes (target: by 2026-03-08).
- Sync w/ Priya on headcount availability (quick 20-min).

Notes to self (short):
- Keep language outcome-oriented: "reduced time-to-contribute" > "onboarding tasks created".
- Avoid overclaim: qualify pilot vs org-wide.
- Bring one concrete ask per meeting slot; prioritize promotion evidence first.

Loose brainstorm ideas for future signals to collect:
- 90-day product/ops win log: link to small wins directly tied to new hires.
- Interviewer calibration dataset: before/after scoring distribution charts.
- New hire NPS question in week 6.

Quick prep checklist for 1:1:
- One-pager promotion packet (attached).
- 2–3 concrete stories (listed above).
- Ask phrasing (see "Asks I want").
- Evidence folder links (confluence, slack, metrics).

---
Edits/notes: move this into a cleaned doc after manager sync. Keep copy of raw Slack quotes in evidence folder. If manager asks for more quant, point to JIRA-POPS-1123 and JIRA-ANALY-559.

[scratch end]
